_note: HLR's concrete lexicon for voice_lint.js (concrete-noun, family and product features) and verify_packets.js (family-named signal). Derived, not ratified. product: single words for what HLR makes, the stones, parts and metals in the display names of brand-pack/products.json (2026-10-17 catalog snapshot) plus four materials the corpus names at least twice. scene: single concrete nouns of HLR's world (places, objects, nature, the body), chosen by lane C [derived] and kept only where the corpus re-cut uses them at least twice (counts under evidence, [observed]). product_families: the family keys of products.json, verbatim. product_names: every display name in products.json (the house-style name, 'in' in place of a dash), so a line that names a product earns product credit. Words match whole and case-insensitive with plain plurals; a two-word stone name is listed as its words. Re-derive from the brand owner's keeps once favorites exist (pack contract, concrete_lexicon); re-key product_names when HLR's export replaces the snapshot.
